verdict.rationale: Simular's own materials say Sai can rerun a taught workflow on a schedule (simular-docs-14). Its documented REST API (POST /v1/agents/message), Python SDK and MCP server let external code or agents trigger tasks programmatically rather than only interactively (simular-docs-1, simular-docs-10, simular-docs-11, simular-docs-6). missing for 10: detailed scheduling docs (cron syntax, schedule management), documented inbound event triggers or webhooks beyond calling the API, and independent or hands-on corroboration that scheduled runs work.
